title: FutureLens: Longitudinal Topic Patterns in Scholarly Text and Future-Work References
abstract: arXiv:2610.28656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Future-work statements offer a record of the questions researchers choose to leave open. Using them to describe a field, however, requires separating thematic change from changes in document coverage, topic assignment, and scholarly writing. FutureLens examines these measurement issues in a recovered snapshot of 5,655 ACL papers published during 2012--2022, including 4,005 with supplied future-work reference text. We compare non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) and latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA), aggregate topic presence at the paper level, and examine normalized prevalence, exploratory trend statistics, assignment stability, and agreement between input-derived text and references. Across available seeds, NMF has higher mean normalized pointwise mutual information (0.1387 versus 0.1280) and higher pairwise assignment stability, while LDA has greater keyword diversity (0.8900 versus 0.7750). translated_title: FutureLens：学术文本与未来工作参考文献中的纵向主题模式
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28656v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：未来工作陈述记录了研究者选择留待日后解决的问题。然而，要用它们来描述一个研究领域，需要将主题的演变与文档覆盖范围、主题分配以及学术写作风格的变化区分开来。FutureLens 在一个恢复的快照数据集上考察了这些测量问题，该数据集包含 2012 至 2022 年间发表的 5,655 篇 ACL 论文，其中 4,005 篇附有未来工作参考文本。我们比较了非负矩阵分解（NMF）与潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）两种方法，在论文层面聚合主题出现情况，并考察了归一化流行度、探索性趋势统计、分配稳定性，以及输入文本派生的主题与参考文献之间的契合度。在不同的随机种子下，NMF 具有更高的平均归一化逐点互信息（0.1387 对比 0.1280）和更高的成对分配稳定性，而 LDA 则具有更大的关键词多样性（0.8900 对比 0.7750）。种子为零的结果显示流行度呈上升趋势……
tldr: FutureLens 基于 2012–2022 年 5,655 篇 ACL 论文，系统考察了利用“未来工作”陈述追踪学术领域主题演变时的测量方法问题，并比较了 NMF 与 LDA 两种主题模型在稳定性、信息量与关键词多样性上的表现差异。
